title: Lupin the 3rd Chronicles
native_title: ルパン三世 クロニクル
overview: Lupin the 3rd Chronicles is a database fan disc featuring a library of video clips, character information, and music from the Lupin the 3rd anime franchise. Included in the game is a so-called "Lupin Maniac Quiz", which contains numerous questions about the Lupin anime series. If the player can correctly answer 10 questions in a row, they'll be rewarded with a bonus video clip. Three different packages were released with different cover illustrations, but the contents are identical between all three.
